title: Compose designs from shared technical entities
statement: As an Architect, I can reference existing Systems, Components, and data entities in implementation decks so my designs use consistent application concepts grounded in the application codebase.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Two implementation decks can reference the same System, Component, or data entity identity and its saved definition without creating independent copies of that definition.
An existing entity referenced by a deck exposes its recorded exact code references and their current or stale state; the link alone does not assert that the code is current.
A deck can explain its own use of the shared entity while retaining the link to the canonical definition.
